question.text: When a nominee is empowered to operate the account of a physically incapacitated investor who gives a thumb/toe impression or mark, any encashment by such nominee shall be credited only to:

answer.text: The bank account linked to the account of the investor
Any bank account provided by the nominee

explanation.text: The Logic: Where a nominee is empowered to operate the account of a physically incapacitated investor who gives a thumb/toe impression or mark, any encashment by such nominee must be credited only to the bank account linked to the investor's account. The Trap: Crediting 'any bank account of the nominee' would defeat the safeguard — proceeds are restricted to the investor's linked bank account. Note: The disabled party in this rule is the investor, not the nominee; the nominee operates on behalf of the incapacitated investor.
